title: How to support your partner's dreams

slides.title: Learn *the details*
slides.body: The names, the deadlines, the hard parts.

slides.title: Protect *their time*
slides.body: Take something off their plate so they can work.

slides.title: Be their *first fan*
slides.body: Share it, show up, clap loudest.

slides.title: Dream *together* too
slides.body: Make room for one shared goal.

slides.title: Save this *for their next big idea.*
